claude_proposed_widenings.name: GrantedSpellAreaOverride.relative_to_granted_spell
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The current surface can only override a granted spell with a concrete AreaShapeSpec. This item modifies Web by reference to the spell's printed area instead of naming a new fixed shape, so a relative multiplier is needed to encode it honestly.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "The web created by the spell fills twice its normal area."
